lines.en: label kaorispecial35:
scene nightsky
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone in hopes that she isn’t currently standing in the middle of the road and attempting to drown herself in rainwater.
That would be quite hard to do right now given that it isn’t raining, but seeing as literally nothing has ever made sense while I’ve been with her, I don’t want to say it’s impossible.
It’s always raining somewhere — just never around me.
That really tells you a lot, doesn’t it?
: Paper!
: Well, that’s a new one.
: Help to unfold!
: By any chance, is your Japanese regressing? Because you’ve been doing pretty...okay lately when you’re not completely zoned out and soaking wet.
: You lack the understanding, Friend! The thin, fragmented corpse of a fallen tree was attached to my entry block when I arrived at house tonight! I am worried of what secrets it contains!
: There was some sort of...paper taped to your door? It’s probably just an eviction notice or something. Have you been paying your rent?
: I deliver a smaller tree-corpse to the groundwoman on the beginning day of every month! And a discount poster for the creaming as well! That can not be it!
: Just open it up and find out.
: Are you sure that my safety is guaranteed?
: Sure, why not.
: Then...unfold!
: Ah!
: Are you being evicted after all?
: No! It is something much less horrible than that!
: It is a treasure map!
: It’s what?
: Treasure! And directions on how to locate it!
: You must join me, Friend! Adventure is currently patient!
: It’s like 9:00 PM. Do we really have to go on a treasure hunt now?
: Yes! I will see you at my cubic dwelling in the coming moments! I must prepare!
: Kaori-
scene black
What I didn’t know at the time of that phone call is just what “treasure” awaited us.
And how pressing the right button at the right time would ultimately change our lives.
scene map1
But that’s enough shifting tenses for now.
The story you’re more interested in is the one unfolding right before your very eyes.
Like a map — or a guide on how to take a step forward without cutting your leg-hands on clear, malformed sand.
It matters not what the future holds, but how we get there and how many gashes we are able to avoid along the way.
In the coming hours, you will encounter something you do not understand.
But, contrary to the way things normally are, it’s something you won’t instinctively look away from.
I tell you this not as someone recollecting the past, but as someone experiencing the present right there with you.
Open your eyes.
Hold out your arms.
And accept this gift from those who think you need it-
Even if you feel like you don’t.
: Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...
: Can I see-
: I understand where we must go. But before we embark on our grand adventure, I must strengthen my cock.
: I am referring to my chicken cock.
: Just “chicken” is fine. Where is he anyway?
scene map2
: What the actual fuck?
: Kaori, this isn’t normal. That is not a chicken, it is a monster. And we will one day become its food.
: Impressive cock! And with an insatiable appetite!
: As his matriarch, I am very proud! He is the growing boy! And the guardian of the image box!
: What are you even feeding him that allowed him to grow to that size?
scene map3
: Yes.
: That is not an adequate answer to that question.
: I do not understand what the issue you appear to have is.
: That’s because your brain is broken, so I will help you. Your chicken has grown to an unreasonable size that makes me doubt it is even a chicken in the first place. He is impossibly large.
: Every pizza is a personal pizza if you try hard and believe in yourself.
: What?
: The meaning of that word string is not one of cheese, but of hope.
: What?
: Do not be jealous of my cock because it is so very large. Believe in yourself and find your own. Make your dreams no longer dreams, but memories of a dream. That is what it means to live.
: Kaori, he’s going to die at this rate.
scene map4
: Die?
: Reverse-live.
: I know the meaning of the word, Friend. But John is healthier than he has ever been before on a diet of cornmeal and New Guinea flatworms. He will be fine.
: The cock only grows to the size of its apartment anyway. I am sure his growth spurt is nearing the reverse-beginning.
: Kaori-
scene map5
: Enough of the cock-gobbling, Friend! We have treasure to discover and this map extends far beyond the reaches of my housing-cube!
: Well...where are we going exactly?
: To where the trees live.
: The forest? Or...a treehouse? I feel like the answer could be either of those things.
: The answer could be many things! But my treasure-senses are strong in terms of this one! All you need to do is follow me! To wherever I may roam!
scene map2
: I think you’ve had enough, John.
: YOU...KNOW NOT...WHAT AWAITS YOU...
: I CAN TELL YOU...FOR A PRICE...
: WORMS...PLACE THEM IN MY MOUTH...
: I WANT TO...FEEL THEM CRAWL...
scene black
: Drat! My insect supply has been reduced to ten minus ten!
: I am sorry, John! But there is a chance our treasure will contain more of your favorite snack if it is buried underneath the ground! Please wait patiently at house!

Kaori and I exit “house” as she tucks the map into her back pocket, but I’m unable to comment on how ridiculous this is on account of my mind getting caught up on an animal roughly twice my size instead.
I’m sure it doesn’t do me any good worrying about such a thing when it’s clear there are some...oddities in this world to begin with.
But I wonder at what point they started becoming “oddities” in the first place?
I wonder if there was ever a time without giant chickens or recycled worlds. When men roamed the streets freely and fewer girls felt inclined to spread their legs for me.
I’m glad that this is where I live, though. And that being detached from reality has become what’s truly “real” to me.
scene map6
But then again, there are moments like this where I’m being dragged through a forest...that I really do wish I was back in bed at home, with a niece who sees me as an uncle just one room over.
This ridiculous world is fine when it favors me, but it is Hell when it doesn’t.
And in this case, Hell is filled with the steam of a natural hot spring and a girl who should not be allowed outside of the house alone.
: Kaori...we’ve been wandering through the woods for an hour now. Are you sure whatever you’re looking for is here?
: We are getting close, Friend. The map tells me so.
: You’ve been saying that this whole time. Also, the map can’t tell you anything. It is a map.
: Is the purpose of a map not to direct the human or human equivalent that holds it?
: It...is. But definitely not in the way you’re making it sound.
scene map7
: Cheer up, duck that is made of rubber! If you are worried that the forest will swallow you, I can keep your human mind at ease with a fun game!
: What kind of game can we play in the middle of the woods? Because the only one I can think of is one I’m almost certain you are not mentally mature enough to play yet.
: An information game!
scene map8
: Anything you want to know, I will tell you! And then you will tell me a thing you know!
: I read in the friendship book that sharing stories with someone is the best way to make them love you! And there is no one who loves me, so such a thing sounds like it would be good and necessary!
: I’m sure Yuki-
scene map9
: That is a different form of love.
: The one I speak of is violent and passionate and would inflict a great deal of harm to both of us. But it would be a welcome instance of pain and suffering we would not trade for the world.
: It...what?
scene map10
: Kaori...we’ve been wandering through the woods for an hour now. Are you sure whatever you’re looking for is-
scene map11
: Wait, what?
: We are getting close, Friend. The map tells me so.
: Friend?

: I’m sure Yuki-
scene map9
: That is a different form of love.
: The one I speak of is much harder to comprehend.
: It hurts. But it feels so good.
: It’s terrible. But it’s also wonderful.
: ...Kaori?
scene map14
: What is it, Friend? We are getting close. The map tells me so.
: Are you...starting to feel a little...strange in here?
scene map15
: Strange?
: My leg-hands are warm from the water and my hair feels very zzzzzzz from the moist air, but I am still Kaori despite those small things.
scene map16
: Oh! Light bulb!
: Maybe you would feel better if we played a game?
: What kind of game can we play in the middle of the woods? Because the only one I can think of is one I’m almost certain you are not mentally mature enough to play yet.
: An information game!
scene map17
: Anything you want to know, I will tell you! And then you will tell me a thing you know!
: I read in the friendship book that sharing stories with someone is the best way to make them love you! And there is no one who loves me, so such a thing sounds like it would be good and necessary!
: I’m sure Yuki-
: Did you ever have someone you loved, Friend?
scene map18
: Did you?
: If this “game” of yours is going to lead to questions like that, I’d probably prefer if we killed time with something else instead.
: Killing is bad, Friend. All life must be treasured.
: If it weren’t for those who valued life, you’d have never met the Queen of Spiders in the first place.
scene map19
: It was just a phrase, Kaori. I don’t really disagree with any of that. And I’m glad you’re here.
: Would it increase your gladness if you were to ask me a reverse-answer before you must reverse-question any of mine?
: Maybe, if I could actually think of something to ask you.
: Anything you want to know, I will tell you.
: Then...
: Since we’re already on the topic, what was it like essentially...coming back from the dead?
scene map20
: Very, very not good! No amount of grape-blood in see-through cylinders can compare to experiencing human life for the second first time!
scene map21
: I do not see it as returning from the unalived, though. I am remembered by Aunt Yukiburger and the slightly smaller, large-chested version of her that accompanies her into buildings sometimes.
: And while these earlier memories have been ripped from my mind like coconuts off of a coconut tree, I can still feel my chest-muscle tighten each time my vision-balls connect with them.
: Is that strange, Friend? Am I mistaken in believing those feelings would not exist if I had truly left this place?
: As someone who has probably never died before, I have no idea. I have heard of people with amnesia experiencing memories like that to some-
scene map22
: ...extent.
: Cheer up, duck that is made of rubber! If you are worried that the forest will swallow you, I can keep your human mind at ease with a fun game!
: Anything you want to know, I will tell you! And then you will tell me a thing you know!
: What do you want to know, Friend?
: What is happening right now?
: Something is waking up.
: Now, it is my turn to ask you a question.
: What did you want to be when you were little?
: I don’t...
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene map23
: We are getting close, Friend. The map tells me so.
: Let me see it.
scene map24
: I want to find the treasure just as much as you, Friend! John needs more bugs and I enjoy taking things out of the ground!
: Do you doubt my ability to decipher text when it coats the body of a fallen tree? Is it because we are surrounded by trees? Do you believe they are manipulating the text with their tree minds?
: I would not doubt it if they were. They are alive, you know. Maybe the reason we have not found it yet is because of their interference?
: Or maybe it’s because you just can’t read. Let me see it.
scene black
scene map25
: What are your thoughts, Friend? Are we as near to the marking as I believe we are?
I stare down at the “map” in Kaori’s hands and question why I followed her all the way out here without taking a look at it in the first place.
This is all a joke, right?
She has an overactive imagination and just came up with some kind of...make-believe treasure hunt so we’d have something to do tonight.
There was never anything to find. And that’s why she didn’t want me to see it earlier. She knew I would catch on and decide against coming with her.
Now, my ankles are drenched and my neck is covered in blood from the fifty or so mosquitos I’ve needed to slaughter while venturing through these woods.
And, on top of that, I think I’ve even begun to hallucinate from overexhaustion or something.
I want to get out of here.
I want this fake treasure hunt to come to an end.
: Kaori...let’s go home.
: What?! But we are so close! Probably! Quitting now would mean walking away from something amazing!
: How are you sure it’s so amazing? It’s one character on a sheet of paper you probably taped to your door yourself. It’s-
scene map26
: No! There is an amazing treasure here! I am sure of it! We can not give up now! We must believe in ourselves! Personal pizza, Friend! Personal pizza!
: Kaori, give it a rest. Please.
: There’s nothing here. I’m tired.
: Was I...wrong?
: No...No, I know this is the right place! I can feel it!
: Then we can...come back or something. But I’m leaving with or without you right now.
: I don’t want to be here anymore.
scene map27
: Hah...
: Okay.
: I can not call myself a worthy companion if I repeatedly ask you to do things that make you unhappy.
: I am sorry, Friend. Please forgive me and do not leave me the way everyone else always does.
: I’m not going to leave you. I just want to get out of the...place where the trees live and go to sleep.
scene map28
: One more reading! Tell me your secrets, tree corpse! And do not interfere, natural wooden pillars!
: Kaori, come on.
scene map29
: Ahhh! Fine!
: But I am very reverse-happy about this!
scene black

$ kaori_love += 1
